title: Uniqueness of native Hom comparisons for fixed representative data
statement: Under the geometric hypotheses of [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models], fix NativeClosedHomModels M. If eta and chi are isomorphisms M.weilHom followed by nativeForget to the ordinary Hom of the forgotten arguments, and both satisfy NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility for the SAME native and ordinary representative data in M, then eta=chi. The representative data are fixed, rather than quantified independently for the two isomorphisms.

source.place: Native constraint lifting step 3: identify fixed product-total Hom comparisons; Stacks 0A95 and 079P.

proof.text: On K-injective P and I, the projection HEq equations for the two comparison witnesses have identical right sides. Product-Hom extensionality degree by degree identifies their underlying complex morphisms. Cancel the common invertible factorization and representative maps in their localization squares.

For an arbitrary pair of derived objects choose the canonical K-injective representatives and their localization isomorphisms. Naturality of eta and chi along the induced product isomorphism, followed by cancellation, reduces equality of their components to the preceding K-injective case. Extensionality of natural transformations and isomorphisms finishes.

theorem native_hom_representative_unique
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (η : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hη : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) η)
    (χ : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hχ : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) χ) :
    η = χ
